headline: China and South Korea Conclude Second Phase of Free Trade Agreement Negotiations
summary: China and the Republic of Korea substantially concluded the second phase of negotiations on their bilateral Free Trade Agreement, according to China's Ministry of Commerce.
why: Bilateral trade agreements reduce tariff barriers and alter export-import dynamics between major manufacturing and trading economies in Asia.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Expanding free trade terms reduces market entry barriers for bilateral commerce.
